hero.name: Abdulroqeeb Ibrahim
hero.role: IT support specialist to full-stack developer · Doha, Qatar
hero.intro: I started by fixing real problems for real users, and now I build the tools that make support easier. React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, with Arabic and English support.

about.title: About me
about.text: I’m an IT support specialist who fell in love with building software. After supporting real users in Doha and Dubai, I started building the tools I wish they'd had. I love technology, and my ultimate goal is to build AI applications.

cards.title: I explain things simply
cards.text: I turn technical problems into plain language, so people understand what's wrong and what happens next.

cards.title: I learn by building
cards.text: Every project here started as something I wanted to understand. QuickDesk taught me authentication, roles, deployment, and Arabic right-to-left layouts.

cards.title: I show up
cards.text: I go to tech events in Doha to meet builders, ask questions, and learn what teams actually need.

about.now: Adding an AI assistant and screenshot uploads to QuickDesk.

projects.title: Projects
projects.also: Also built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript: News Homepage, Age Calculator, Calculator, Color Game. In progress: Order UK, a mobile-first React app.

items.quickdesk: IT helpdesk ticketing system with role-based access, comments, search, and Arabic/English RTL support.
items.todo: Full-stack task manager with an Express API and PostgreSQL storage.
items.contact: Validated form that submits to an Express API and stores entries in MongoDB Atlas.
items.orderuk: Mobile-first food delivery interface built from Figma designs.
items.tickets: Conference ticket generator with drag-and-drop avatar upload, form validation, and a personalised ticket.
